text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thinking it might give Almond Eye a chance to catch her breath, I visited a nature park with her, and...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Gran-chan.
What a coincidence, to think you'd be here too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ai-senpai! Good morn-mile~☆ Yep,
I'm thinking of completing some of "My Rules"!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
“After eating oddly shaped vegetables,
exercise in the great outdoors!”
This park has plenty of play areas, after all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
Hey, since we're here, why don't we look around together?
It'll be way more fun that way!
choice_data_list: Let's all take a break for a change of pace!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we visited the "Challenge Corner."
It looks like visitors can take on all kinds of challenges here.
choice_data_list: Hmm, that's quite difficult, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! That's amazing, Ai-senpai!
You picked it up right away!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I was actually a little confident.
There was a time when I used to juggle balls during training
to improve my motor skills, you see.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Getting the hang of it was pretty tough, but...
thanks to that, my body remembers it by heart. Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! In that case, me too!
Let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, five reps all of a sudden!?
Isn't that a bit tough...?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm all good!
Watching Ai-senpai's movements just now gave me the general idea!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Teyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! To think you actually pulled it off...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've got a bite!
I won't let you get away—hyaa!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*splash!*)
choice_data_list: Incredible! To catch a fish this big...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, who knows?
...A long time ago, I underwent intense training
just to win a fishing tournament.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Since we came all the way out for stream fishing, I'm aiming for an even bigger catch!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Grrrrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What a strong pull...!
At this rate, isn't the line going to snap...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Don't pull it all at once—
just give it little nudges like this... and voilà!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*KABLAASH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whaaat!?
To think you'd reel in such a huge catch...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Ehehe, how's that, Ai-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Such rod control, almost as if she can read the fish's mind...
She really is amazing...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still... even I can...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Sponge Gun Target Shooting Game"...
Oh, so you score points by hitting the targets!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds fun!
Let's do our best and aim for perfection!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll do my best...
I'll pour everything I have into this game!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Taking aim... right there!
choice_data_list: Amazing, that's quite a high score!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Awesome, with this...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Aah, so close!
Just a little more, too~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! No way...
It's practically perfect...!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That's right~.
I ended up missing the very last target.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "Still, it was really fun getting to shoot so much! I hit my own personal goal, too, so maybe it's time to head—"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Ai-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: One more time!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "One more time, let's go one more time...! There is no waaay I'm going home after a loss...!"
choice_data_list: B-But isn't today supposed to be a breather...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That might be true, but it can't end like this!
I'm definitely going to surpass Gran-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
! Amazing, 120 mph of pure passion...!
Just what I wanted! Next time,
I'm aiming for perfection too!

text_block_list.name: Ai & Gran
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAH!
—YAAAAAAH!
choice_data_list: It's turned into a real contest...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Don't rush, lock onto the target—there!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"No way...! Five Perfects in a row!?
I'm still only at three in a row~...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I did it... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...!
And with that, I win!
choice_data_list: I wonder if it ended up being a nice change of pace after all...?
I don't have any regrets left now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...!
And with that, I win!
choice_data_list: I wonder if it ended up being a nice change of pace after all...?
I don't have any regrets left now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're right, my mind feels so clear!
I should be able to sleep soundly tonight♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, wait! One more time, please!
I hate the thought of walking away
after losing, too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're on...
I'm not about to just hand you the win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That might be true for today... but this isn't the end yet.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I lost to Gran-chan in both juggling and fishing.
I'll just have to challenge her again, right!
